urn:eigenius:core:description: DepMap 18Q4 curated omics container (R serialization, readRDS). A named list of cell-line x gene matrices: DRIVE (RNAi dep), CRISPR (CERES dep), GE (log2 TPM expression), CN (log2 relative copy number), MUT_HOT/MUT_DAM/MUT_OTHER (binary mutation), MUT (mutation calls df), RPPA (protein). A multi-schema container consumed member-wise; not a single tabular layout. The member list is stated here rather than in ingest:member: that property is an intra-file selector for ONE member with domain ingest:DatasetSchema, and it was carrying a comma-joined list on the nested ingest:Layout — a domain violation and a malformed value (eigenius#210). Binding each member properly means ingest:schemas with one DatasetSchema per member (D53 §10); nothing consumes the binding today, so the list stays descriptive until something does.
